text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.Welcome back to my class.Please get your student's book and the worksheet ready.In today's class, you are going to learn and practice English grammar.In the previous lessons, we talked a lot about water and the water jobs journey.I'd like to see how much you know about them.Here I've got some questions for you.Question 1.How long did it take for the water job to travel to Daisy's bathroom?A few days.How do you know that?Because in the story, the water job said,A few days ago, I was floating comfortably in the cloud in Jiangxi.What did the water treatment works do to the water job?They gave it a thorough cleaning and added a few chemicals to it.How much water does it take to make one jacket?It takes a lot of water to make one jacket.For short answer, we can say a lot.Do you remember the exact number from the video clip?It takes 20,000 liters of water to make one jacket.That's enough for one person to drink for two years.Last one, true or false?It isn't important to save water because there is so much of it on the earth.It is false.Although there is a lot of water on the earth, 75% of the earth's surface, most of it is salt water.You can't drink salt water.It is very important to save the water we use every day because less than 1% of the earth's water can be used by people.Can you see the words highlighted in red?What do we call them?Right, we call them quantifiers.And they are used to talk about amounts.Actually, we've learned a lot about quantifiers.Let me see how well you know the grammar item.This time, I'd like you to complete a passage.The passage is about the importance of water.It's task one on your worksheet.Complete the passage with proper words in the box.Each word in the box can be used more than once.In some cases, more than one answer is possible.
